record.original_question: If X is an elliptically connected complete Kähler manifold, must its fundamental group π_1(X) be almost abelian, or at least almost nilpotent?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE. If X is an elliptically connected complete K¨ ahler manifold, th en the group π 1(X) is almost abelian (or, in a weaker form, almost nilpotent).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a complete Kähler manifold. Say that X is elliptically connected if any two general points of X can be joined by a connected chain of (possibly singular) holomorphic images of elliptic curves and rational curves in X. A group G is called almost abelian (resp. almost nilpotent) if it contains an abelian (resp. nilpotent) subgroup of finite index.

Question: If X is an elliptically connected complete Kähler manifold, must its fundamental group π₁(X) be almost abelian? In the weaker form, must π₁(X) be at least almost nilpotent?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches reveal active work on fundamental groups of Kähler manifolds and related conjectures (e.g., for projective manifolds with trivial canonical class, or with compactifiable universal cover, fundamental groups are conjectured/known to be almost abelian or almost nilpotent in various settings), but no source directly establishing or refuting the conjecture for elliptically connected complete Kähler manifolds was found. Status appears unresolved in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Compact Kähler manifolds with compactifiable universal cover
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses conjectures that fundamental groups of certain Kähler manifolds are almost abelian.
status_evidence.claim: Related conjectures about almost abelian fundamental groups remain a subject of ongoing research.

status_evidence.title: The Fundamental Group of Kähler Manifolds (Amorós)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Kähler groups; characterization of which groups arise as π₁ of compact Kähler manifolds remains widely open.
status_evidence.claim: General classification of Kähler fundamental groups is still open.
